claims.text: Black Arrow OS is a pocket CRM with drag-and-drop pipeline and follow-up scheduling
It shows a weekly KPI dashboard with CPL and ROAS
It is free forever, no signup, 25 contacts, with the paid Platform being unlimited
The platform threads every text and email per contact into one inbox and lets you reply from anywhere
14-day free trial, no card needed, cancel anytime
Refer another business and you both get a free month when they subscribe, tracked automatically
